output.explanation: Implemented all ten B10 diagram updates from the pinned sources. Alternatives now own placement presentation, saved views own branching and working copies, and managed generation owns isolated child execution and recovery. Existing responsibilities, attachment labels and reserved bounds are preserved. Only the three planned edges are added. These changes establish pinned endpoints and retained generation evidence for later work; B11 comparison sessions and reusable saved AgentContexts remain unimplemented here.
